coverage: Confirmed Google Search ranking updates from March 2024 onward, as listed on Google's Search Status Dashboard (dates in US Pacific time).
how_to_update: Add a row for each new update listed at https://status.search.google.com/products/rGHU1u87FJnkP6W2GwMi/history, then change last_updated. Pull requests welcome.
caveat: Dates were compiled from the dashboard and reports of it. Rows with a note were not re-checked against the dashboard itself.
